 Versus

Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Mr. Pankaj Bhatt, learned counsel 
holding the brief of Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, 
learned counsel for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. R.C. Joshi, learned Brief Holder 
for the State.
3. Ms. Surbhi Goswami, learned counsel 
holding the brief of Mrs. Devika Tiwari, 
learned counsel for respondent no.4. 
4. The petitioner’s name was 
recommended by the Commission however 
he was declared medically unfit due to 
partial eye vision. Petitioner placed on 
record the AIIMS report and as per the said 
report the vision of petitioner 6/6 and 6/6. 
In such an eventuality, there is two 
contradictory report, this Court is of the 
view, let a Medical Board be constituted to 
examine the visibility of the petitioner. 
5. The C.M.O., Nainital is directed to go 
through with the AIIMS report discussed 
with the Eye-Expert and constitute a fresh 
Medical Board and if needed invite expert 
from AIIMS and submit a report in a sealed 
envelope on the next date.
6. Put up on 25.11.2026. 7. Mr. R.C. Joshi, learned Brief Holder 
for the State shall communicate about this 
order to the concerned C.M.O. so that he 
may constitute a Medical Board to examine 
the visibility of the petitioner. 
8. In additional to this State may also get 
the instruction whether the petitioner can 
be accommodate in another suitable post. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 31.10.2026
